economy.summary: His campaign platform says families are struggling with rising costs, housing pressures, and healthcare expenses, and that he supports practical economic policies that strengthen local businesses, agriculture, manufacturing, healthcare, and the local workforce; he says people who work hard deserve good-paying jobs and affordable healthcare.
economy.short: Supports policies strengthening local businesses, agriculture, manufacturing, workforce.

education.summary: Says he supports investment in public schools, teachers, and facilities, expanded access to technical and trade education, and oversight of charter schools; his platform says every student deserves multiple pathways to success, including college, apprenticeships, the trades, agriculture, and service.
education.short: Supports public school investment, trade education, charter school oversight.

healthcare.summary: Has cited prescription drug costs, services for veterans and seniors, and addiction treatment as areas for legislative attention; his campaign platform also says working people deserve affordable healthcare.
healthcare.short: Cites drug costs, veterans and seniors services, addiction treatment.

energy.summary: His platform includes a stewardship plank supporting protection of clean water, healthy soil, farmland, and open spaces, and what it calls practical, balanced approaches that respect agriculture, workers, businesses, and the environment; it does not address energy policy specifically.
energy.short: Supports protecting clean water, farmland, open space; balanced approaches.

economy.summary: Says Pennsylvania families are stretched thin, and that she will fight for fewer regulations, lower taxes, and affordable energy so employers can hire, grow, and stay in Lancaster County.
economy.short: Proposes fewer regulations, lower taxes, affordable energy for employers.

taxes.summary: Supports lowering taxes and reducing wasteful spending, and opposes the state shifting costs onto homeowners through rising property taxes; cites saving nearly $200,000 through streamlined operations as Lancaster County Clerk of Courts.
taxes.short: Supports lower taxes, less spending; opposes rising property taxes.

education.summary: Says parents, not government, should decide what is best for their children, and supports educational choice and removing state barriers so families can select public, private, charter, cyber, or homeschool options without penalty.
education.short: Supports parental rights and educational choice across school options.

guns.summary: Says the right to keep and bear arms is a constitutional freedom, not a privilege, and opposes policies she says burden law-abiding citizens while failing to address violent criminals; citing over 20 years in law enforcement, she also emphasizes supporting police, holding criminals accountable, and prioritizing victims' rights.
guns.short: Defends Second Amendment; supports police, accountability for criminals.
